About This Site
This site is built with Quarto, version-controlled with Git and GitHub, developed directly on an AWS EC2 instance, and deployed automatically via GitHub Actions to GitHub Pages.

title: Welcome to My Website
text:
Welcome to my Quarto website, built for AD688 - Big Data and Cloud Analytics for Business, Assignment 1.


This page embeds a live PySpark job that runs when the site is rendered, proving the cloud-computing environment set up on this AWS EC2 instance actually works end to end.

from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark = SparkSession.builder.appName("Assignment1Demo").getOrCreate()

data = [
    ("Data Scientist", 120000, "Remote"),
    ("Cloud Engineer", 115000, "Boston"),
    ("ML Engineer", 130000, "Remote"),
    ("Data Analyst", 85000, "New York"),
    ("DevOps Engineer", 110000, "Boston"),
]
columns = ["job_title", "avg_salary", "location"]

df = spark.createDataFrame(data, columns)
df.show()

pdf = df.groupBy("location").avg("avg_salary").toPandas()
pdf.columns = ["location", "avg_salary"]

plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))

plt.tight_layout()
